title: Synergy of Large Model and Small Model for Port Safety Management
summary: ZTE reports that its Taicang Port system eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior. Prevented injuries remain unestablished.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZTE reports deployment and 65 tests at Taicang Port, where its system eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior. The account provides no independent verification of these gains. Prevented injuries remain unestablished.
purpose: Improve port risk detection while reducing false alarms.
system: ZTE Nebula hybrid port-safety vision system

ratings.reason: The deployed port system reportedly eliminated 92% of false fire positives and identified unsafe activity. Prevented harm remains unestablished.
Safer working conditions are intended. Injury and exposure outcomes remain unreported.
Stronger logistics resilience is intended, with no public safety effect quantified.

ai_role.statement: An edge detector flags possible fire or smoke and a larger cloud vision model checks context to reject false positives. Safety outcomes also depend on human response.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Synergy of Large Model and Small Model for Port Safety Management

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Existing CCTV coverage with edge detection and cloud verification

headline: Port AI checks alarms and spots safety risks
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
